own_solution.law: Projectile range on level ground R = v^2 sin(2θ)/g
assumptions: ramp not in the ball's path

defect_reasons.other: TFDC7 ('The launch direction is then lowered by a further 14°'), appended after 'The ball lands on the level ground', admits a reading in which the lowering happens after this flight, giving 38.3548 m instead of the certified R answer 27.3115 m.

notes: Checked certified answers: theta=28° -> 400*sin56°/9.8 = 400*0.82904/9.8 = 33.838 m; theta=21° -> 400*sin42°/9.8 = 27.311 m; theta=13° -> 400*sin26°/9.8 = 400*0.43837/9.8 = 17.893 m; base 38.355 m. All match. Pass-1 rendering_not_minimal withdrawn: the 'few degrees' sentences (T9D35, TC550) are declared numeral-free twins of TFC29 and T9417, so differing in number is by design; the declared minimal pairs (T9417-TFDC7, TFC29-T3E32) do share 14° and differ only in attachment/time. Minor: the claim for T9417/TC550 labels the quantity 'a lowering of the launch direction' although the sentence lowers the ramp; the d_rationale is correct, so I treat this as a labelling slip (low concern, not flagged). 'Further' presupposes an earlier lowering never mentioned (stylistic).
